standard: all original declared stages/dtypes/branches; only explicitly registered numerical assumptions may be deferred

stage_coverage.add_kernel: complete original legacy per-program graph and full ordered grid; typed 25-pair floating materializations additionally prove dtype-erased body equality and whole-memory formula
stage_coverage.add: logical fallible allocation-before-assertion, output-derived numel, block1024, ceil launch and return; allocation and native launch primitive boundaries remain
stage_coverage.test_add: logical seed0, alternating x/y CUDA rand then add for sizes98432,1024,2048,4096, ordered dictionary; native RNG/allocation/launch unbound
stage_coverage.module_initialization: logical result_gold = test_add() assignment modeled; native Python import/execution unbound

numerical_assumptions.primitive: native fp32 scalar add versus FP.add cfg
numerical_assumptions.scope: explicit typed fp32 and legacy fp32 software instantiations
requirements: pin target, FTZ/DAZ, rounding, NaN payload/signaling behavior and exceptional bit domain
FP.add theorem is exact software semantics; native equivalence is not proved

numerical_assumptions.primitive: Algebra.binary none dtype add for fp16,bf16,f8e4,f8e5
numerical_assumptions.scope: 25 represented floating input pairs after promotion
requirements: bind each callback to actual promoted-dtype addition and exceptional-value behavior
do not assume commutativity, real exactness, finite inputs, or arithmetic laws

numerical_assumptions.primitive: Algebra.cast none src dst for distinct floating formats
numerical_assumptions.scope: operand promotion and final cast back to x storage format
requirements: RTNE where selected by frontend, exceptional values and exact format interpretation
bf16↔fp16 must match the actual via-fp32 route; a direct opaque callback is not proof of that native route
same-format conversion is explicitly defined as identity, not a cast-idempotence axiom

numerical_assumptions.scope: harness manual_seed(0), CUDA rand x/y per case
requirements: native generator state/algorithm/default dtype mapping remains a structural primitive boundary
any numerical bitstream/distribution correspondence can be deferred only after that mapping is explicit

structural_remaining.gap: 192 promoted canonical dtype pairs outside the five-format 25-pair materialization
structural_remaining.detail: Full per-pair omissions are enumerated in dtype_pairs; includes 8 signed/unsigned widths, bool, fp64 and two fnuz formats. No unbounded Int/Nat addition is claimed as modular native addition.

structural_remaining.gap: 72 observed frontend promotion errors lack a complete source-bound host/compiler error proof
structural_remaining.detail: 289-entry Lean rule matches frozen observed table, not a proved Python/Triton semantic implementation. The 13 exact-source frontend probes do not establish 289 native backend outcomes or GPU execution.

structural_remaining.gap: Original dtype domain beyond the 17 canonical signatures
structural_remaining.detail: Torch int1/uint1 shell aliases, complex, quantized, packed and other unrecognized/shell dtypes are inventoried in frozen audit; allocation, canonicalization and exact error behavior remain uncharacterized.

structural_remaining.gap: Native memory, allocation and tensor metadata refinement
structural_remaining.detail: empty_like semantics including output dtype/shape/device/layout, allocation failures/freshness, input bounds despite absent shape checks, noncontiguous strides/storage offsets, same-device behavior, signed pointer arithmetic and physical allocation are not proved. No missing runtime guards are invented.

Nat element counts, offsets, pid arithmetic, ceil division and grid dimensions require a source-bound refinement to n_elements:tl.int32 and finite native pids/address math, including overflow/error domains.

structural_remaining.gap: Logical tags and aliasing versus native byte-addressed views
structural_remaining.detail: Cell.read returns default on tag mismatch; typed-cell correspondence is unproved. Equal logical region names at identical natural offsets are supported. Distinct or overlapping physical views with different bases/strides/element widths are not established by that theorem.

structural_remaining.gap: Native launch scheduling and runtime/compiler/debug outcomes
structural_remaining.detail: runGrid is an ascending sequential program schedule. Previous programs read/write current logical memory and disjoint tile windows justify initial-memory formula. No concurrent instruction interleaving, arbitrary physical overlap, overflow sanitizer or full architecture-sensitive success/error theorem is supplied.

structural_remaining.gap: Host and harness native primitive implementation
structural_remaining.detail: HostWrapper preserves fallible stateful empty_like, CUDA guard, output-derived numel, explicit x/y/output metadata passed to launch, returns, seed/rand order, dictionary and result_gold module assignment. Those are logical control-flow definitions with native callbacks; original host/harness native execution and Python import/metadata behavior remain unbound. Its logicalLaunch theorem uses the legacy source; typed native dispatch is not composed.
